definitions.explanation: One of the seven days that make up a week.

examples.english: What day of the week is it today?

examples.japanese: ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's school from Monday to Friday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧{曜日|ようび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My favorite day of the week is Saturday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I take piano lessons every Friday.

examples.japanese: {曜日|ようび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧、⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}てしまった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I got the day wrong and came to class by mistake.

notes:
USAGE:
{曜日|ようび} is both a stand-alone noun meaning 'day of the week' as a category, and the suffix that turns one of the seven element kanji into a weekday name. The element kanji takes its on'yomi before it, so the seven names are formed regularly and only need to be learned once.

DAYS OF THE WEEK:
- ⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧ (Sunday) - ⟦{日|にち}→日：02249_hi⟧ = sun
- ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧ (Monday) - ⟦{月|げつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ = moon
- ⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧ (Tuesday) - ⟦{火|か}→火：02248_hi⟧ = fire
- ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧ (Wednesday) - ⟦{水|すい}→水：02258_mizu⟧ = water
- ⟦{木曜日|もくようび}→木曜日：00653_mokuyoubi⟧ (Thursday) - ⟦{木|もく}→木：00524_ki⟧ = wood
- ⟦{金曜日|きんようび}→金曜日：00642_kinyoubi⟧ (Friday) - ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ = gold/metal
- ⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧ (Saturday) - ⟦{土|ど}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ = earth

SHORTENED FORM:
In timetables, TV listings, store signs, and casual speech, the final {日|び} is often dropped: ⟦{火曜|かよう}→火曜：13459_kayou⟧ for ⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧, {水曜|すいよう} for ⟦{水曜日|すいようび}→水曜日：00672_suiyoubi⟧, and so on. The short form is normal in writing and in speech among friends, but the full form with {日|び} is always safe and is what learners should use by default.

COMMON QUESTIONS:
- ⟦{何|なん}→何：03100_nan⟧{曜日|ようび}？ (What day?)
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：03100_nan⟧{曜日|ようび}？ (What day is today?)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧ (week), ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧ (weekday), ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧ (weekend).
